subject: general
question: Which team won the T20 cricket event, Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy 2022-2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mumbai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Mumbai** won the S**yed Mushtaq Ali Trophy** for the first time in the **2022-2023 **season.
 
• The Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy is a** domestic T20 cricket competition** in India, organized by the **Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI)**.
 
• It is named after the famous Indian cricketer Syed Mushtaq Ali who was known for his aggressive batting style.
 
• Mumbai **defeated Himachal Pradesh** in the final to clinch the title.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy**

 
 
• The Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy is an Indian domestic T20 cricket championship.
 
• It was first introduced in the **2006-07 season**.
 
• Named after Syed Mushtaq Ali, a former Indian cricketer known for his aggressive batting and contributions to Indian cricket.
 
• It is organized by the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) and is a crucial platform for players to showcase their talents and make a case for national selection.
 
 

**Domestic Cricket Formats in India**

 
• **First-Class Cricket:**

 
 
• Format similar to Test cricket.
 
• Played over 4 days (some tournaments like Ranji Trophy have 5-day finals).
 
• **Key Tournaments:**
 
 
• Ranji Trophy: Prestigious inter-state competition.
 
• Duleep Trophy: Zonal competition.
 
 
 
 
 
• **List A Cricket:**
 
 
• Format similar to ODIs.
 
• Played at the domestic level.
 
• **Key Tournaments:**
 
 
• Vijay Hazare Trophy.
 
 
 
 
 
• **T20 Domestic Cricket:**
 
 
• Played at the state level.
 
• **Key Tournaments:**
 
 
• Syed Mushtaq Ali Trophy.
